acceptanceCriteria.text: Inventory all CI/release dependencies in `.github/workflows/**`, `.github/actions/**`, and directly related release scripts, including Action refs and Action-installed tool versions.
Update `oras-project/setup-oras` to a current supported stable revision and keep it pinned by immutable commit SHA.
Use a current stable ORAS CLI version that is explicitly verified compatible with that pinned `setup-oras` revision.
Add a pre-publication validation/smoke path that detects an invalid `setup-oras` × ORAS version combination before the release publication stage.
External GitHub Actions are aligned to supported current stable releases while retaining immutable SHA pins.
No unintended external `@main`, `@master`, or other floating refs remain.
Repository/internal `yohn-jp/.github` floating refs are either replaced by an explicit immutable/versioned contract or documented as deliberate exceptions with a clear authority.
Duplicate version literals for the same tool are reduced to a single authority where practical.
GitHub Actions dependencies supported by Dependabot remain automatically updateable through the existing `github-actions` configuration.
Tool-version values that Dependabot cannot update have an explicit validation/update mechanism rather than being silently left stale.
Dependency policy is enforced by a regression check so future stale/floating references fail CI with a clear diagnostic.
The failed 0.9.1 release path can proceed through ORAS setup and OCI publication after this change without weakening release identity or supply-chain guarantees.

issue.title: chore(ci): normalize CI and release toolchain dependency ownership
